xverify.cmd_desc: Cross-verify a claim on a DIFFERENT provider; the host derives ALLOW/NO-GO/HOLD from typed evidence
xverify.err.author_model_provider_mismat: --author-model "{model}" belongs to provider "{modelProvider}", not the claim author "{author}" — the author model must be one the author provider can actually run.
xverify.err.author_required: --author is required and must be one of: {providers}. The verifier is chosen to DIFFER from it.
xverify.err.self_verify: Verifier must differ from --author ("{provider}") — self-verification defeats the purpose of an independent second opinion.
xverify.err.target_file_not_found: Target file not found: "{path}" — check the path is project-relative and exists.
xverify.err.target_invalid_spec: Malformed --target entry "{spec}" — expected path:START-END (1-based inclusive line range) or path:symbolName.
xverify.err.target_range_invalid: Target range invalid for "{path}": {start}-{end} (file has {total} lines). Ranges are 1-based and inclusive.
xverify.err.target_symbol_not_found: Symbol "{symbol}" not found in "{path}" — pass an exact identifier that appears verbatim in the file, or use a path:START-END line range instead.
xverify.err.unknown_author_model: Unknown --author-model "{model}" — it must be a canonical model id present in the model registry. Omit the flag to fall back to the resolved default (recorded as low-confidence).
xverify.err.verifier_tier_below_author: Verification refused: verifier model {verifierModel} (tier {verifierTier}) sits BELOW the author model {authorModel} (tier {authorTier}). A second opinion is only worth its cost from an equal or higher capability tier. Pass --verifier-model with an equal-or-higher tier model, or state the true author model with --author-model.
xverify.err.verifier_tier_floor_unresolv: Verification refused: the author/verifier capability tiers could not be resolved from the model registry ({detail}), so the tier floor cannot be proven. Register the exact model ids or pass --author-model with a canonical registry id.
xverify.final_only_risk: Risk: {verifier} reports usage only when the call ends — token ceilings settle afterwards. Containment for this call is the host wall clock: {seconds}s.
xverify.mcp.author: Provider that authored the claim; verifier must differ
xverify.mcp.diff: Record a bounded host-side git diff context; v2 evidence remains broker-owned
xverify.mcp.files: Comma-separated exact project-relative evidence files — scopes the diff evidence to exactly these paths when diff is also requested
xverify.mcp.title: Cross-verify (host adjudicated)
xverify.mcp.verifier: Explicit verifier provider; must differ from author
xverify.mcp.verifier_model: Exact canonical verifier model API id
xverify.nogo_criteria: The bounded evidence directly contradicts a material factual premise or proves a concrete safety, correctness, evidence, or dependency-order gap. Missing evidence alone is not NO-GO; it requires UNCLEAR.
xverify.opt_author: Provider that authored the claimed work ({providers}) — the verifier must differ. Required.
xverify.opt_author_model: Model id that authored the claimed work (canonical provider API id, e.g. claude-opus-5) — the verifier must run at an equal or higher capability tier. Omitted: the resolved default is used and recorded as low-confidence.
xverify.opt_diff: Attach `git diff HEAD` as evidence context for the verifier
xverify.opt_files: Comma-separated list of files the claim says were changed — when --diff is also passed, scopes the attached diff to exactly these paths
xverify.opt_json: Machine-readable JSON output (for the MCP twin / session-to-session use)
xverify.opt_target: Comma-separated bounded targets `path:START-END` (1-based inclusive line range) or `path:symbolName` — extracts an exact excerpt so a large file never needs manual prompt surgery
xverify.opt_verifier: Explicit verifier provider (optional; must differ from --author; default: cross_verify.verifier_priority)
xverify.opt_verifier_model: Explicit verifier model id (canonical provider API id, e.g. gpt-5.6-sol) — bypasses tier-equivalence resolution, never the author tier floor
xverify.prepare.approval_summary: Authorize a bounded reachability probe for verifier {provider}/{model} (docker, owner-budgeted)
xverify.prepare.approval_wait_timeout: approval wait bounded by --timeout ({timeoutMs} ms) expired — request {requestId} is still undecided; reporting the typed approval_undecided hold.
xverify.prepare.hold: Candidate evidence preparation HOLD — reason: {reason}, detail: {detail}, evidence: {evidence}. The run continues; the composition will report the same typed hold.
xverify.remedy.adjudication_budget_unava: The non-reservable subscription adjudication requires an owner-authored execution_budget.purposes.xverify-adjudication profile with a positive maxTokens ceiling and wall clock; it is missing or its total-token ceiling is not positive, so the arm holds rather than dispatch without a ceiling. Add the profile (maxTokens, maxWallClockSeconds, maxVerificationsPerRun) to the owner config, then rerun xverify.
xverify.remedy.approval_authority_unavai: Missing authority: the approval authority runtime. Enable approval.authority (enabled + tenant_id, plus terminal.max_auth_age_seconds for local-terminal decisions) in the owner config.
xverify.remedy.approval_consumed: The probe approval {requestId} was already consumed by a prior attempt (single-use). Approve a fresh request to authorize another probe.
xverify.remedy.approval_rejected: The probe approval {requestId} was denied by the operator. No probe will run for this scope until a new request is approved.
xverify.remedy.approval_undecided: Missing authority: a live-authenticated probe decision. Decide request {requestId} via `deckent approvals decide {requestId} --allow` at an interactive terminal, then rerun xverify.
xverify.remedy.approval_untrusted: The decision for {requestId} carried no live re-authentication and was refused fail-closed. Decide it over a live-authenticated channel (interactive `deckent approvals decide` or the OIDC API).
xverify.remedy.backend_identity_unavaila: Missing authority: the digest-pinned Docker runtime identity. Ensure the docker daemon runs and the pinned verifier image (with the provider CLI) is present, then retry.
xverify.remedy.budget_profile_unavailabl: Missing authority: the owner-authored probe budget. Author execution_budget.purposes.reachability-probe (token ceilings + timeout; usd only for metered API) in the owner config.
xverify.remedy.evidence_refresh_hold: The canonical evidence producer held: {producerReason}. Cooldown/singleflight holds clear by themselves after their window; other reasons name the exact failing source.
xverify.remedy.limit_unit_unreservable: The verifier is a subscription provider whose only limit windows are advisory percent-remaining — never numerically reservable, so the adjudication call cannot open a reservation. Either provision a metered/API path for the verifier (usd/token windows), or set cross_verify.allow_non_reservable_subscription_adjudication: true in the owner config to admit it via the typed non-reservable outcome.
xverify.remedy.model_activation_authorit: Missing authority: the project model-activation store exists but cannot be read safely. Repair its availability or schema before retrying; no verifier call was made.
xverify.remedy.model_inactive: Missing authority: the verifier model is inactive in the project owner policy. Activate the exact model with deckent models activate, then rerun xverify.
xverify.remedy.no_evidence: No bounded evidence attached to this claim — pass --files <path[,path...]>, --diff, and/or --target <path:START-END|path:symbol> so the verifier has something concrete to check; an unevidenced claim is unlikely to produce a confident verdict.
xverify.remedy.usage_unavailable: The Fable-to-Sol call dispatched, but the canonical transport reported no usable usage, so no numbers were fabricated and the package stays OPEN. Confirm the verifier CLI emits its token counters (provider version/flags), then rerun xverify.
xverify.report.author_model_low_confiden: LOW CONFIDENCE — resolved default substituted; --author-model was not stated
xverify.report.cumulative_usage: **Cumulative host usage:** {turns} turns · {tokens} total tokens · {cacheRead} cache-read tokens
xverify.report.tier_admission.normal-tie: **Tier admission:** normal tier admission (no owner-pair exception used; host/config policy, not a verifier verdict)
xverify.report.tier_admission.owner-pair: **Tier admission:** owner-pair exception admitted (host/config policy; not a verifier verdict)
